profileNote: The draft's introspection query was rejected ("Unknown argument "includeDeprecated" on field "directives" of type "__Schema""). The introspection types lack __Directive.isDeprecated, __Directive.deprecationReason and __Schema.directives(includeDeprecated:), so this run asks the draft's query without them, grades against the draft, and counts what they lack once, under builtinDefinitions.

checks.title: The response is a well-formed execution result: data, errors only as a non-empty list, extensions a map, nothing else
The query executes, and its result has exactly the fields it selects, nulls included
queryType, mutationType and subscriptionType are the root operation types
types is the set of all named types
types has the built-in scalars the schema references, and no others
__type(name:) returns the named type, and null for a name the schema doesn't have
Each __Type has its type's kind, and its fields are null exactly where that kind requires, List and Non-Null included
An object's or interface's fields, with their types
Field and directive arguments, with their types
defaultValue is null for an input value without a default, and otherwise null or an encoding of the default
defaultValue encodes the default value of an input value that has one, rather than returning null
checks.basis: §4.2.4: "defaultValue may return a String encoding (using the GraphQL language) of the default value used by this input value in the condition a value is not provided at runtime. If this input value has no default value, returns null." By Appendix A, a lowercase "may" keeps its RFC 2119 meaning, so the encoding is optional; the intent is plainly that a default is encoded, which makes this a SHOULD. A string that isn't an encoding of the default, or one for an input value without a default, still fails defaultValue.

checks.title: An input object's inputFields, with their types
An enum's enumValues
interfaces, and possibleTypes for unions and interfaces
isDeprecated, deprecationReason and includeDeprecated; @deprecated is returned when the schema deprecates something
specifiedByURL is a custom scalar's @specifiedBy URL, otherwise null
isOneOf is true exactly for OneOf input objects
checks.note: Draft only: October 2021 has no OneOf input objects.

checks.title: A description the document gives is returned as it is, the schema's included
checks.basis: §3.2: documentation is "written immediately alongside definitions in a TypeSystemDocument and made available via introspection", which has no key word, and §4.2 says of every description field that it "may return a String or null". So a description the document gives that is lost or replaced fails this SHOULD, and any description is accepted for a definition the document doesn't describe ("" or one of the service's own included).

checks.title: directives describes the schema's own directives (name, locations, isRepeatable), and returns any built-in directive the result shows is provided (@specifiedBy for a specifiedByURL, @oneOf for a true isOneOf); any of the service's own takes input types
@skip and @include are provided, @specifiedBy when the schema has a custom scalar, @oneOf when it has a OneOf input object
The introspection types and built-in directives are as the spec defines them, with nothing left out or changed
The fields of the introspection types have the Non-Null wrapping the spec gives them
checks.basis: The types of the introspection fields are given only by the definitions §4.2 introduces with "Below are the full set of type system definitions providing schema introspection, which are fully defined in the sections below", which has no key word. The sections below say what each field returns ("isRepeatable must return a Boolean"), and a field whose type differs only in Non-Null can still return exactly that. Any other change of type stays under builtinDefinitions, a MUST.

checks.title: The introspection types have no field, argument, enum value or type the spec doesn't define
checks.basis: No sentence of §4 forbids extending the introspection types. The nearest is "Below are the full set of type system definitions providing schema introspection, which are fully defined in the sections below", which uses no key word, and Appendix A says "A conforming implementation of GraphQL may provide additional functionality, but must not do so where explicitly disallowed". Leaving out or changing a definition stays a MUST, under builtinDefinitions.

checks.title: Under the October 2021 profile, a built-in definition that differs from October 2021's is as the draft defines it
checks.basis: The kit grades against the draft; the October 2021 profile is a fallback for a service whose introspection types the draft's query can't ask. A built-in definition (or an addition) that is exactly the draft's breaks nothing the draft requires, so it is reported here, not under builtinDefinitions or builtinAdditions.
checks.note: Graded only under the October 2021 profile.

checks.title: __typename names the root type, and no fields list includes it
Fields, arguments, enum values, directives, members and interfaces come in source order
checks.note: Draft only: October 2021 has no Stable Ordering.
